description: Header file defining data structures and declarations related to undoing resolve operations in a version control system, likely Git. It includes structure definitions, function prototypes for recording, writing, reading, clearing, and unmerging undo information.

methods.name: record_resolve_undo
methods.description: Records undo information for resolve operations in the index.

methods.name: resolve_undo_write
methods.description: Serializes undo information to a string buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_read
methods.description: Deserializes undo information from a buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
methods.description: Clears undo information from the index.

methods.name: unmerge_index_entry
methods.description: Removes undo information from a specific index entry.

methods.name: unmerge_index
methods.description: Removes undo information from the entire index based on a pathspec.
